intro.ko: 구독 해지 완료 화면을 봤는데 이번 달 요금이 결제됐어요.
intro.de: Obwohl du eine Kündigungsbestätigung gesehen hast, wurde der Monatsbetrag abgebucht.
intro.en: You saw a cancellation confirmation, but this month's fee was still charged.

scenario.intent: 해지 시점과 결제 내역을 순서대로 설명한다

note.en: Thank you. Please check why I was charged.
